rows.ARS:
Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: BAR 4482, BARottoc
rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink.. Strong, apple, damask, tea fragrance. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Rose Barni describes the color of the blooms as tones of salmon and apricot.

And from the Barni web site:

Grand Prize and Gold Medal for the fragrance to the International Biennal of Nantes, 1999. It is vigorous, resistant to the diseases, very good blooming and it has big flowers. The colour is a warm salmon and apricot tonality, fast until the complete opening of the flowers. It has an agreeable and strong fragrance. Height cm. 90/110
